title: Generics and constraints — concept map
intro: Generic type parameters, extends constraints, keyof indexed access, default type params, Result wrappers, and variance — the compile-time polymorphism that erases completely on emit.

overviewDiagram.title: Generics learning path
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart LR
  A["Generic fn/class"] --> B["extends constraints"]
  B --> C["keyof + T[K]"]
  C --> D["default type params"]
  D --> E["Result wrappers"]
  E --> F["variance in/out"]

conceptCards.title: Generic functions and classes
conceptCards.summary: T preserves input-output relationship. Inference from args; explicit <T> when needed.

conceptCards.title: extends and keyof
conceptCards.summary: T extends Foo unlocks members. K extends keyof T enables safe get(obj, key): T[K].
conceptCards.example: function get<T, K extends keyof T>(obj: T, key: K)

conceptCards.title: Default type parameters
conceptCards.summary: T = unknown when omitted. Required params before defaulted ones.

conceptCards.title: Result and Option wrappers
conceptCards.summary: Discriminated Ok | Err union. map/andThen railway. Throws vs Result tradeoff.
conceptCards.example: type Result<T, E> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: E }

conceptCards.title: Variance basics
conceptCards.summary: Params contravariant, returns covariant. readonly T[] covariant; mutable invariant.
